title: Redefining Generalization in Visual Domains: A Two-Axis Framework for Fake Image Detection with FusionDetect
abstract: arXiv:2510.05740v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid development of generative models has made it increasingly crucial to develop detectors that can reliably detect synthetic images. Although most of the work has now focused on cross-generator generalization, we argue that this viewpoint is too limited. Detecting synthetic images involves another equally important challenge: generalization across visual domains. To bridge this gap,we present the OmniGen Benchmark. This comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporates 12 state-of-the-art generators, providing a more realistic way of evaluating detector performance under realistic conditions. In addition, we introduce a new method, FusionDetect, aimed at addressing both vectors of generalization. FusionDetect draws on the benefits of two frozen foundation models: CLIP & Dinov2. translated_title: 重新定义视觉域中的泛化：面向伪造图像检测的双轴框架与FusionDetect方法
translated_abstract: 生成模型的快速发展使得开发能够可靠检测合成图像的检测器变得日益关键。尽管目前大多数工作聚焦于跨生成器泛化，我们认为这一视角过于局限。检测合成图像还涉及另一个同等重要的挑战：跨视觉域的泛化。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了OmniGen基准。这一综合性评估数据集包含12个最先进的生成器，提供了一种更贴近现实条件下评估检测器性能的方式。此外，我们引入了一种新方法FusionDetect，旨在同时解决这两个泛化方向。FusionDetect利用了两个冻结基础模型的优势：CLIP和Dinov2。通过从这两个互补模型中提取特征，我们构建了一个统一的特征空间，能够自然适应内容和设计上的变化。
tldr: 本文提出了OmniGen基准和FusionDetect方法，通过结合CLIP和Dinov2的特征，同时解决伪造图像检测中的跨生成器和跨视觉域泛化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the OmniGen benchmark and FusionDetect method, which combines features from CLIP and Dinov2 to address both cross-generator and cross-domain generalization in fake image detection.
